field_basic.caption: User attends marker C; CCA ρ for C rises above threshold, dwell filling.
ENGAGED → C: planned path around obstacles, LiDAR hits in blue.

field_queue.caption: ENGAGED → A with D queued (numbered badge 1 on D).
Short glance at E: ρ(E) spikes but the dwell never completes → no selection.

field_no_control.caption: No-control: ρ bars flicker during glances but stay below threshold or never dwell.

field_overrides.caption: Teleop override: mux source TELEOP while the goal B stays active.
E-stop latched: lock active, zero velocity.

supermarket_walker.caption: ASSIST at the entrance; markers are virtual MR overlays (not physical objects).
Shopper crossing: collision monitor active (user-inclusive footprint).
User pulls back: navigation scaled down, the user wins.
Grip released: dead-man lock, walker stopped.
User's view at the Beans: MR marker overlay, walker in ASSIST.
